title: Too Much Blue
description: Too much Blue is a Blue-themed resource pack for PvP featuring blue textures for weapons and items.
body:
Too Much Blue is a blue-themed PvP resource pack featuring blue textures for weapons and items. Please note that the pack is still under development, and I highly recommend using a Low Fire resource pack alongside it for a better PvP experience until I add that feature myself.

Enjoy! :)
